messages.subject: How to input numbers and change the output accordinglu
parts:
Hi all,

I am new here, so please forgive me if somebody has already asked this.

I am currently working on an app which displays a table with say 2 columns and 10 rows. The first column has numbers that I get from my analysis results. The second column would initially be blank. What I would like to do is to make the second column editable and the first column to change accordingly. What I mean by that is, I should be able to input values in the second column(for all the rows), and the values in the first column should in turn reflect those changes. Suppose the first value in the first column is 10. When I enter 4 in the second column, the value in the first column should become 6 and so on.

I would really appreciate any help or guidance.

Thanks in advance!
